thread:
Maya (Marketing): Hey team — draft of the launch blog is up. Link: https://docs.google.com/draft-redwood-launch. Can folks please check narrative flow, the benchmark callouts, webinar CTA, and the HubSpot form mapping by EOD? Quick ask: can we get legal OK and product signoff before Friday?

Josh (Product): Thanks Maya — skimmed. I left inline comments on the model performance paragraph; suggest we swap the 99th perc latency stat to p95 to avoid flakiness in the claim. Also can we add a one-liner about Dedicated capacity for enterprise customers?

Marco (Design): I updated the hero image variant — added the alt-text and a small diagram that shows Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private. Preview in the doc. Hero CTA color choices: `#0A84FF` (primary) vs `#1558D6` (slightly darker). Leaning dark.

Priya (Sales): For inbound routing — we need the webinar registrants to go to HubSpot list "Launch_Webinar_Registrants" and sales leads to SFDC with leadsource=launch_blog. Can we add UTM tags to the CTA buttons?

Maya (Marketing): Good catch Josh + Priya. I've updated the doc: replaced 99th with p95 and added a Dedicated line. Added UTMs to CTAs.

Maya (Marketing): HubSpot mapping snippet (please verify IDs):
```
webinar_cta -> hubspot_form: 87521
ebook_cta -> hubspot_form: 87522
sales_cta -> hubspot_form: 87523  # create Company + Contact, source=blog_launch
```

Monica (Legal): Quick read — overall fine. Two asks: (1) remove the line that calls the performance "industry-leading" (we can say "best-in-class" or provide a sourced benchmark), (2) small privacy note for the webinar registration on data retention. I'll paste suggested wording in the doc.

Evan (Growth): Can we include a short A/B test plan for the CTA? Variant A = "Get started free" Variant B = "Book a demo". I can wire this into the GA experiment and capture conversion via the HubSpot form submits.

Liam (Ops): FYI — if webinar registrants have IP-based region constraints, the Private deployment mention should include APAC availability timeline. I can confirm infra dates tomorrow.

Josh (Product): Re: Monica, agree — swap phrasing to "measurable improvements in latency and cost" and point to our benchmark appendix. For the Dedicated line, add one sentence about SLA and reserved capacity.

Marco (Design): Small UX note — webinar CTA on mobile should be sticky; CSS snippet in the doc. Also updated the hero image alt copy for accessibility.

Priya (Sales): Confirming the HubSpot IDs look right for the forms. Two items: (1) Need hidden field `lead_source=launch_blog` on the sales_cta form, (2) Can we add a follow-up sequence: immediate thank-you email + 2-day nurture with webinar recording link. I can draft the sequence if marketing OKs.

Maya (Marketing): Awesome — Priya please draft nurture sequence. Monica, thanks for the legal text, I'll add. Evan — we'll run the CTA A/B for the first two weeks post publish. Liam — flag if APAC timeline slips.

Monica (Legal): Added privacy blurb and removed the industry-leading claim. Added sentence: "We retain registration data for 24 months; contact data is handled per our privacy policy."

Josh (Product): OK from product side pending final wording on the benchmark appendix link. Add the appendix link and I'm good to approve.

Maya (Marketing): Added appendix link to benchmark doc. Small publish checklist I put at the bottom of doc:
- Final copy approval (marketing, product, legal)
- Design assets uploaded (hero, social cards)
- HubSpot forms live and tested
- A/B experiment created in GA
- Webinar scheduled + speaker list + recording flow tested

Evan (Growth): I'll create the GA experiment and the UTM mapping now and post results to the doc.

Priya (Sales): Drafted the 3-email nurture, posted in the doc under "post-reg nurture".

Liam (Ops): APAC infra availability confirmed for week of June 8. No blockers.

Maya (Marketing): Great — who can do a final pass for tone + one-liner hero change?

Josh (Product): I'll do the final read for product accuracy.

Monica (Legal): I approve the legal copy.

Marco (Design): Design assets are uploaded and named: `redwood_launch_hero@2x.png`, `social_card_launch.png`.

Maya (Marketing): Final approvals: Product: Josh ✅ (commented), Legal: Monica ✅, Design: Marco ✅. Evan: please confirm experiment creation and HubSpot tests tomorrow. Priya: handoff to Sales automation when forms live.

Priya (Sales): Ready to onboard leads once HubSpot forms tested.

Evan (Growth): Created GA experiment ID `ga_2026_launch_01` and verified tracking on the staging page. HubSpot form submits are showing on staging.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Publishing window: target publish Thursday 11:00 PT. If no objections, I'll schedule the post and webinar registration live at 09:00 PT that morning.

Josh (Product): No objections from product.

Monica (Legal): No objections from legal.

Marco (Design): Looks good.

Priya (Sales): Good to go.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks all — scheduling now. :tada:
